verdict.rationale: Canva ships an official, documented Apps SDK for building apps that import content, add elements to designs and automate design tasks inside the editor, backed by an official CLI for creating and managing those apps. For the REST/Connect APIs, Canva provides an OpenAPI description to generate client SDKs rather than first-party client libraries. missing for 10: official first-party client SDKs for the REST/Connect APIs (codegen only), documented language/runtime coverage of the Apps SDK, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Use the Canva Apps SDK to bring new design and editing experiences into the Canva editor.
You can use the Apps SDK to create apps that import content into Canva, add elements to a user's design, automate common design tasks, and more.
Leverage a command line tool designed for creating and managing Canva apps.

Canva provides an OpenAPI description of the REST APIs. You can use this with code generation libraries, such as [openapi-generator](https://github.com/OpenAPITools/openapi-generator), to generate client SDKs in various languages.
